{{Top|leg}}
'''Thulpin Guard''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-allied military unit maintained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as part of the [[Planetary Guard]]. They wore grey and red uniforms, with a white helmet trimmed with red. The Thulpin Guard were comprised of eight [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], armed with [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]] and [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-axs]], as well as a [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]]. They fought in the [[Battle of Bissillirus]], during the planetary raid on [[agricultural loading platform XT-21s]].
